summary: Physical locations where the clinic sees patients.
purpose: Each branch groups its rooms and its office hours. Patients choose a branch when booking online and the team works with an active branch.
tips: An inactive branch is no longer offered for booking, but keeps its history.

config.sedes.btn.new.description: Opens the form to create a branch.

config.sedes.field.name.description: Short name the team recognizes (Downtown, Pocitos…).

config.sedes.field.address.description: Address: used on the map, in reminders and on the portal.

config.sedes.field.is_active.description: If unchecked, the branch doesn't show up for booking.
